chunk.content: Activate the continuity assessment immediately for an unsafe site or a multi-site essential-service closure. chunk.content: HarbourLink Services classifies disruptions affecting customer centres, online services, payments, facilities and operational records. The recorder captures discovery time, affected service and site, observed impact, current owner and unknown facts. A service request without disruption is not an incident. chunk.title: Incident Classification Standard
chunk.content: Severity 1 (SEV1) applies when at least 500 customers are affected, when a customer-facing digital or payment service is continuously unavailable for 30 minutes or longer, or when there is credible immediate danger to people. A multi-site closure that prevents essential customer service is also SEV1. Any one threshold is sufficient. An outage lasting 35 or 45 minutes therefore meets the duration threshold even if the impact count is unknown. Suspected impact is validated urgently; classification is precautionary while safety facts are uncertain. Escalation is defined in POL-INC-002 section 2.
